Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans, building sizes, ages, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, roofing, electrical, plumbing, lighting, technology infrastructure, and ADA compliance; connects condition data to student outcomes and integrates short- and long-term capital planning (Chunks 1-27).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 6 years with methodology explained; includes district-wide and site-specific capacity utilization data with square footage and classroom counts; connects projections to specific facility needs including new school construction and portable replacements; addresses new development impacts and adaptive uses (Chunks 8-29, 34-54).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with extensive educational specifications developed through stakeholder committees; clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; detailed analysis of how facilities support multiple programs including TK, CTE, special education, collaborative learning, and technology; includes flexible and innovative learning environments (Chunks 55-69).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces with references to landscaping, shade structures, outdoor learning centers, amphitheaters, and campus greening strategies at multiple sites; mentions connections to wellness and outdoor learning but lacks fully districtwide detailed data on green space coverage or stormwater management (Chunks 12-13, 17, 26, 29).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related facility needs such as shade structures, HVAC upgrades, and security improvements; references to energy resilience and some mitigation strategies; however, lacks comprehensive climate risk assessment or districtwide climate resilience as a central theme (Chunks 12, 17, 26).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Detailed energy efficiency and resilience strategies including HVAC upgrades, LED lighting, solar photovoltaic arrays, battery storage, microgrids, electrification plans, and alignment with Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals; includes data on energy use and cost estimates; connects energy resilience to climate-related disruptions (Chunks 12, 17, 26, 29, 31, 33, 37, 39, 41, 43, 45, 47, 49, 51, 53, 55, 57, 59, 61, 63, 65, 67, 69, 71, 73, 75, 77).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates for all projects including modernization, new construction, site improvements, and portable replacements; includes prioritization framework based on multiple criteria; outlines multiple funding sources including State grants, developer fees, CFDs, and GO Bonds; discusses long-term financial sustainability and funding challenges; includes project prioritization formula and tiered project lists (Chunks 1, 26, 29, 30, 33, 36, 53, 54, 72, 74, 76, 78).
